notes.title: Patch v1.1
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33844742/abbeb94a95d5d698ff1ec0ee15e953c0a656d4af.png

Gameplay Improvements

Rain and cloud weather chance adjusted for each map.
Improvement of the strike system to strike and gook a fish more smoothly.
The Pike Lake logging cabin challenge is now working as intended.
Air and Inflatable Boats are now working properly in the Everglades and Colorado.
Wait, Strike and Retrieve status are now correctly indicated on the rod pods.


Graphics and Audio Improvements

Improvement of the water effects in front of the boats.
Adjustment of the water transparency on Black Forest.
Fixed more graphical and audio issues.
